source_policy: read-only historical discovery archive + official MLB game logs

definitions.hr_at_lag: The Nth prior PA-game contained >=1 HR; a player can qualify at multiple lags.
definitions.most_recent_hr_exactly_lag: The Nth prior PA-game contained >=1 HR and all more recent prior PA-games contained 0 HR.
definitions.best_price: Highest archived available price across FanDuel, DraftKings, BetMGM at that checkpoint.
definitions.book_specific: Counterfactual ROI using that book's own archived quote for the same qualified selection.
definitions.staking: 1 flat unit per bet; win profit at archived American odds; loss -1u.

warning: Exploratory multiple-comparison search. Treat high-ROI small cells as hypotheses, not validated rules; confirm on forward/out-of-sample checkpoints before promotion.
